Email Signature · Available

Email Signature

An email signature for Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Email Signature has these main features: Name, title, company, phone, email, website, address and social links; Four templates, your colour and font, a logo or photo. It opens Any image.

What you can do with Email Signature

  • Make a Gmail signature
  • Make an Outlook email signature
  • Make an Apple Mail signature
  • Make an HTML email signature
  • A free WiseStamp alternative, in your browser
